Setup.Name: Constant value
Setup.Description: Ignores the payload and returns a constant value.
Setup.Manifest:
Version: 1.0

MqttConnections:
  - Name: "My broker"

OtelConnections:
  - Name: "My Otel server"
    ServiceName: "my-service"
    ServiceNamespace: "my-service-namespace"

Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Provides the current processor temperature."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Name: "Processor information"
          Topic: "sensor/temperature"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "constant.value"
          Description: "Just a constant value."
          SignalDataType: Float
          Instrument: Counter
          Value: "CONST('1')"
